headline: Sharks’ Alex Wennberg out week-to-week with upper-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Sharks forward Alex Wennberg is out week-to-week with an upper-body injury after missing San Jose's 4-3 overtime win over Montreal on Tuesday. The outlet also reports that Igor Chernyshov is out long term after a shot from Matinpalo struck his left arm while he was blocking it.

Chernyshov's loss matters more than his four points in 11 games might suggest. He has two goals so far this season against an expected total of about 1.25 (expected goals measures the quality of his chances), so he has run a little hot, and a modest 13.6 minutes a game is not a huge workload. But SJS controls 6 percentage points more of the expected goals when he is on the ice, and the team is at 44.4 percent for the season, so it can ill afford to lose a helpful piece. San Jose is 6-4-1, and goalies have carried it, saving 8.1 goals more than expected.

Going by how the coach has used his players, with no games missed yet to go on, Alexander Wennberg (20:21 a night) is next in line for Chernyshov's minutes.
